page: Static plugin for serving static files/folders. Install @elysia/static. Config: assets default 'public', prefix default '/public', ignorePatterns default [], staticLimit default 1024, alwaysStatic default false, headers default {}, indexHTML default false. Default folder 'public' with '/public' prefix. Supports nested directories. Available paths: /public/file.png. File helper for single files.

sections.manifest: Config options. Assets folder path default 'public'. Prefix registration path default '/public'. IgnorePatterns list of files to ignore. StaticLimit 1024 router registration limit. AlwaysStatic boolean skip limit. Headers object for response headers. IndexHTML boolean serve index.html for unmatched requests.
Single file with file() helper. Alternative to static plugin. file('public/takodachi.png'). Simpler for single files.
